caption:
Need a perfect square photo? ✂️ Crop any picture to 1:1, 4:5, 16:9 or 9:16 in seconds.

1. Open image.315tools.com and tap Crop & rotate
2. Add your photo
3. Pick a ratio (1:1 makes a square)
4. Tap Convert and save your photo

Free · No sign-up · Your images never leave your device 🔒
